findings.evidence: and fifty years of Tom Vane were floating in front of the men who had known him.
findings.diagnosis: The narration states the elegy outright at the highest beat — the clearest instance of the narrator delivering the tidy validation the contract bars, while the men are silent and no character has moved.
Rennie echoing Aldous's exact words forms a warm matched cadence; for a woman who does not console with words, a drier non-matching confirmation holds her model harder.
